brief.symptoms: The test suite fails with 'kafka: insufficient data to decode packet, more bytes expected' when encoding and decoding DescribeGroupsResponseV1plus messages.
brief.evidence:
request_test.go:33: Decoding empty version 3 failed: kafka: insufficient data to decode packet, more bytes expected
describe_groups_response_test.go:270: case empty decode failed, expected:&{Version:3 ThrottleTimeMs:0 Groups:[] AuthorizedOperations:0} got &{Version:3 ThrottleTimeMs:0 Groups:[] AuthorizedOperations:-1}
hints: The failure occurs when the broker sends a DescribeGroups response with no consumer groups.
Look at the `DescribeGroupsResponse` struct in the `sarama` package.
The bug is related to a field that is conditionally encoded based on the protocol version.
brief.lesson: When adding optional fields to a Kafka response, ensure the field is always encoded even when its value is zero, otherwise the broker will send an incomplete packet that fails to decode.
